details.description: Yi-34B-200K-Capybara (listed on Fireworks AI as "Nouse Capybara 34B V1.9") is a 34.3-billion-parameter fine-tune by Nous Research of 01.AI's Yi-34B-200K base model. Nous trained it on its Capybara dataset, a collection of largely newly-synthesized, reasoning-focused multi-turn conversations, and it inherits the base model's 200,000-token context window. It is intended for long-document handling and multi-turn reasoning tasks rather than as a general chat-safety-tuned assistant.
advantages: Inherits the 200,000-token context window of the Yi-34B-200K base model, which 01.AI reports ranked first among open-source models on English and Chinese benchmarks including the Hugging Face Open LLM Leaderboard and C-Eval.

Fine-tuned on Nous Research's Capybara dataset, whose creator states most of its tokens were newly synthesized rather than reused from existing online text, with an emphasis on reasoning and logic across physics, biology, math, chemistry and culture.
disadvantages: No benchmark scores for this specific fine-tuned checkpoint were found on Fireworks AI's model page or elsewhere.
Built on 01.AI's original Yi-34B-200K release, whose pretraining data extends only through June 2023.
use_cases: Long-document summarization and analysis using the extended 200K-token context window
Multi-turn conversational tasks emphasizing reasoning and logic
Question-answering and text generation across science and reasoning domains, per the Capybara dataset's documented scope
